chains.title: Null: rs7001688 has no TF-mediated regulatory effect
predictions: No allele-specific reporter, ATAC or ChIP signal at chr8:57573391 in hepatocyte models (Hep 3B2.1-7, HepG2).
No liver eQTL for FAM110B, CYP7A1 or any other gene is attributable to this variant, consistent with E07.
No GWAS credible set for LDL cholesterol contains this variant (E04, E05).
Base editing or deletion of the 50 bp around the site in hepatocytes changes no neighbouring transcript.
falsified_if: A reproducible allele-specific regulatory effect (MPRA or luciferase, or allele-specific ChIP/ATAC) is shown for G vs T at this position.
Fine-mapping places rs7001688 in an LDL credible set with non-trivial posterior probability.
CRISPR perturbation of the site alters expression of a lipid-relevant gene in hepatocytes.

chains.title: FOXA2 forkhead site created by the T allele, acting on FAM110B
chains.element: Unannotated candidate element at chr8:57573391 (no overlapping cCRE, E03)

links.claim: The T (alt) allele is proposed to create a forkhead-like core; FOXA2 is named within the forkhead family as the hepatic pioneer factor, but this choice rests on background knowledge, not on cited data. No QBiC-SELEX lookup for FOXA2 was performed, so coverage is not_checked, and no ChIP evidence at this site was supplied (E08 covers HNF4A only).
A pioneer factor could act on a closed, registry-absent element; E03 shows no cCRE within 500 bp, which is compatible with but does not support a cryptic element.
FAM110B is the nearest protein-coding gene at 420.6 kb (E02) and appears in one statin-response genome-wide study (E06), but the variant is not an eQTL for it in any GTEx tissue (E07).
Effect would be confined to FOXA2-positive hepatocytes; no expression evidence was supplied for the Hep 3B2.1-7 context.
Gain of FOXA2 binding would raise FAM110B expression and modestly shift plasma LDL; no cited evidence connects FAM110B expression to LDL at this variant (E04, E05 show no association records).

predictions: ATAC/DNase footprint or open-chromatin signal appears preferentially on T-allele haplotypes.
FOXA2 (or FOXA1) ChIP-seq in HepG2/liver shows a peak within 100 bp of the variant.
MPRA shows T > G activity, the opposite direction to H2 and H4.
FAM110B, not CYP7A1, responds to CRISPRi of the element.
falsified_if: No forkhead core is created by G>T on either strand in a motif scan or QBiC model.
FOXA2/FOXA1 ChIP-seq in liver or HepG2 shows no peak within 1 kb.
FAM110B expression is unchanged by allele or by deletion of the element.

chains.title: CEBPB bZIP site lost on the T allele in a hepatic element near EH38E3835076
chains.element: Candidate hepatic element within the 1.5 kb window containing the CA-H3K4me3 cCRE EH38E3835076

links.claim: The G allele is proposed to support a C/EBP half-site; CEBPB is chosen within the C/EBP group on hepatocyte-expression grounds that are not evidenced here. No QBiC-SELEX lookup was done, so coverage is not_checked, and no ChIP evidence for CEBPB at this site was supplied.
The only nearby annotation is a CA-H3K4me3 cCRE 1544 bp away; the variant itself overlaps no cCRE and is non-conserved (GERP 0.27), so the element assignment is speculative.
FAM110B is the nearest gene at 420.6 kb (E02); no eQTL supports the link (E07).
Hepatocyte context as supplied (Hep 3B2.1-7); no expression data cited.
Loss of CEBPB binding on T would reduce element activity and FAM110B expression with a small upward LDL shift; no association evidence exists for this variant (E04, E05).

predictions: CEBPB ChIP-seq peak in HepG2 or liver overlapping the variant, allele-biased toward G.
Allelic reporter difference appears only under C/EBP-activating conditions (e.g. IL-6 or dexamethasone).
Any signal localises to the 1.5 kb window around EH38E3835076 rather than to the variant base alone.
falsified_if: CEBPB ChIP-seq shows no occupancy in liver or hepatoma lines.
Condition-dependent reporter assays show no allelic difference under C/EBP activation.

chains.title: HNF4A DR1 site in a cryptic hepatic enhancer acting on CYP7A1
chains.element: Putative distal hepatic element at chr8:57573391, absent from the ENCODE cCRE registry (E03)

links.claim: The G (ref) allele is proposed to carry a DR1-like nuclear-receptor motif bound by HNF4A, with T disrupting it. No QBiC-SELEX model was retrieved for HNF4A, so coverage is not_checked; the only direct test available, ENCODE ChIP-seq in HepG2, shows no HNF4A peak containing the variant and none within 100 bp (E08), which argues against this link.
No cCRE overlaps the variant and none lies within 500 bp (nearest CA-H3K4me3 element 1544 bp away), so any enhancer would have to be unannotated; the site is also poorly conserved (GERP 0.27, E01).

CYP7A1 is the nearest bile-acid/LDL gene at 926.8 kb (E02); no eQTL supports this link, since the variant has zero significant GTEx v8 eQTLs in any tissue (E07), and Open Targets shows no CYP7A1 association with a large-LDL cholesterol trait (E09).
Any effect would be hepatocyte-restricted; the supplied context is Hep 3B2.1-7, but no expression evidence for HNF4A or CYP7A1 in this line was provided.
Less HNF4A binding on T would lower CYP7A1 transcription and raise plasma LDL; no cited evidence links this variant to LDL (E04, E05 show no association records).

predictions: HNF4A ChIP-seq in primary hepatocytes or liver tissue (not just HepG2) would show a peak at the site, higher on G.
Promoter-capture Hi-C in liver shows contact between chr8:57.57 Mb and the CYP7A1 promoter.
Reporter activity in Hep 3B2.1-7 is lower for T than G, and the difference is abolished by HNF4A knockdown.
falsified_if: HNF4A ChIP-seq in liver tissue also shows no occupancy at this position (already negative in HepG2, E08).
No chromatin contact between the variant and CYP7A1 is detected.
Luciferase/MPRA shows equal G and T activity.

grades_v0.reason: No evidence cited; the DR1 motif and HNF4A binding are asserted from memory, with no QBiC, ChIP or expression data. Coverage is not_checked.

E02 shows only that CYP7A1 is 927 kb away. No eQTL, contact or CRISPR data link the variant to CYP7A1. Distance alone is not evidence.
No evidence is cited for HNF4A or CYP7A1 expression in Hep 3B2.1-7; the claim comes from memory.
No cited evidence links the variant to LDL. E04 and E05 show no association. The direction (less binding, lower CYP7A1, higher LDL) is plausible but unsupported.
No evidence is cited. The TGTTT forkhead core is proposed with no QBiC result. FOXA2 was picked from the forkhead family because of its expression, which is not shown.
The absence of a cCRE in E03 is read as consistent with a cryptic element. That is not evidence, and no accessibility data are given.
E02 gives FAM110B as the nearest gene, but it is 421 kb away. E06 is a statin-response study with no showing of FAM110B-LDL link at this variant.
No FOXA2 expression evidence is cited.
No evidence ties FAM110B expression to LDL or shows a gain-of-binding effect. The claim is speculative.
No evidence is cited. The C/EBP half-site is asserted, and CEBPB was chosen from the group on expression grounds with no data.
E03 shows only that a CA-H3K4me3 cCRE lies 1.5 kb away. The variant itself is unannotated, so the assignment is speculative.
E02 shows FAM110B is nearest, but at 421 kb. A nearest-gene rule is not evidence.
No evidence is cited.
No evidence is cited for FAM110B-LDL or for an effect of CEBPB loss.
No evidence identifies a linked variant or an NR1H4 element change. This link also cites NR1H4 for a variant that is assumed not to alter binding.

No evidence is cited.

grades_final.reason: The only cited evidence (E08) is a negative HNF4A ChIP result in HepG2, with no peak containing or near the variant. It contradicts the claim. No QBiC-SELEX or other binding evidence for the G allele was supplied. Coverage is 'not_checked', so a qbic_tf_detail lookup for HNF4A would be the check.
E03 shows no cCRE within 500 bp, and E01 shows no regulatory feature and low conservation (GERP 0.27). Nothing cited supports an enhancer here; the evidence argues against it.

CYP7A1 is 926.8 kb away (E02). There is no GTEx eQTL (E07), no Open Targets association (E09), and no contact data. Proximity at that distance is not evidence, and the cited evidence does not support the link.
No evidence ids were cited and no HNF4A or CYP7A1 expression in Hep 3B2.1-7 was provided. The context label alone does not establish the claim.
E04 and E05 show no GWAS or Open Targets records for this variant, so there is no LDL association. The claimed direction (less binding, lower CYP7A1, higher LDL) has no supporting data.

FAM110B is 420.6 kb away (E02). The E06 literature hit is a statin-response study that does not show regulation by this variant. E07 shows no eQTL. Nothing cited supports the variant-to-gene link.

next_experiment: Run a QBiC-SELEX detail lookup at chr8:57573391 for FOXA2 (and, in the same call set, CEBPB and HNF4A): it is existing-data cost, establishes true coverage instead of not_checked, and directly tests the only remaining non-null claim with meaningful probability (H3, gain of a forkhead site on T) against the null H1.
